name: Front of the Class — Brad Cohen with Lisa Wysocky
description: Memoir about Brad Cohen's experience of Tourette syndrome and becoming a teacher.
intended_use: Inspect a Tourette lived-experience and education/work perspective without treating one life story as a universal account.
audience_or_context: International / not jurisdiction-specific; readers seeking memoir and lived experience about Tourette syndrome.
limitations: Memoir does not establish prevalence, prognosis or what Tourette syndrome looks like for every person.
The book is not diagnostic or treatment guidance.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial book; format, price and territorial availability vary.
conflicts_of_interest: The authors and publisher have a commercial interest in the book.
